title: Bergman Kernels and Hankel Operators on Weighted Fock Spaces in Several Complex Variables
summary: We introduce a class of plurisubharmonic weights on \mathbb C^n and develop a theory of the associated weighted Fock spaces F_\varphi^p. The curvature assumptions are imposed on a \mathcal C^2-regularization at bounded distance from the original weight. Thus the original weight need not be smooth or strictly plurisubharmonic, and, even when it is of class \mathcal C^2, its complex Hessian eigenvalues need not be uniformly comparable.
